run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to create a UMA finetuning dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_finetune_config: create YAML config files for UMA model finetuning with dataset paths, normalizer RMSD, and linear reference coefficients
run_launch_processing: run parallel processing to convert ASE atoms objects directories into a format ready for finetuning
run_compute_normalizer_and_linear_refere: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that generates UMA finetune template YAML and data task YAML configuration files
